desc: Analyze problem and derive mathematical conditions for no dead ends on torus
Determine parity requirements: rows and columns must have even number of A tiles
Derive r_ij values for B cells based on parity of A's in row prefix and column prefix
Establish consistency condition: for any rectangle of B cells, XOR of r values = 0
Formulate final answer: 2 if B cells exist and system consistent; 2^(H+W) if no B cells
Design O(HW) algorithm to compute parities, r_ij, and check consistency
Implement solution handling up to 10^5 test cases with total cells ≤ 10^6
Test against sample inputs and verify outputs match expected results
